description: Release qualification corpus as of 0.36.0: the decks (new ones in decks/, existing examples by path), the PPTX variants to export, the run tiers, and per feature the slides, what to check and what each application is expected to make of the feature's object (targets). build.mjs exports it; run-powerpoint-windows.ps1 probes it through COM and evaluate.mjs grades the probe against the checks below; scripts/libreoffice grades the same features in LibreOffice Impress; the native-testing program (docs/programs/native-testing/README.md) runs it in Keynote and compares a run with the targets.

smoke.description: About ten decks that together show every object kind, a hidden slide, a right-to-left slide, a chart of each family Keynote reads differently and the decks behind the most serious known differences, plus the decks named by unreleased changelog fragments.

decks.why: A hidden slide (10) followed by a live slide number (11, kn-hidden-slide-numbering); titles, text, a bulleted list (6), a table (5), charts (3, 4), pictures, links on words (2), presenter notes and footer placeholders on one deck. The reader-keynote variant (--reader keynote: Office-safe typefaces, static slide numbers, SmartArt as shapes, native body text) runs here so each smoke run sees the whole Keynote profile on the deck with every object kind.
Footer, live slide number and date placeholders; a live number beside footer text (kn-slide-number-beside-footer-text), and the static variant that avoids it.

Every gallery layout; body placeholders in the native-body variant; the only open known difference in OPF's own file (kn-native-note-at-foot, slide 24 of native-body), long titles and grown table headers (kn-title-overprints, kn-table-header-split). The reader-keynote variant shows the Keynote profile on every layout; it runs here and not on the other profile decks to keep the tier small (those run in release).

One chart of each classic family Keynote reads differently: stacked area labels (3), stacked lines and direct labels (4), radar with lines (5), doughnut (6), the map written as columns (7), scatter labels (9), an area gap (13), a combo with a secondary axis and a reference line (14), negative bars (15), a one-series highlight (16) and a chartex histogram (17); Keynote's copy fails OPF's import (kn-import-missing-value).
Extended charts that Keynote shows as OPF's picture and Impress cannot draw (kn-extended-chart), and Keynote's own axis scale (kn-automatic-axis-scale).
Overlays anchored to chart points, a pie, and the General number format Keynote shows with one decimal (kn-general-one-decimal).
Right-to-left slides (Arabic 2, 3 and 8, Hebrew 4) with a right-to-left chart and numbered list; Japanese, Chinese and Devanagari with their default fonts.
Live SmartArt, which PowerPoint lays out, Keynote shows as OPF's picture fallback and Impress draws from its drawing part; OPF's own arrangements as native shapes.
Mermaid diagrams as OPF's groups of shapes, lines and text boxes.
Glued connectors, rerouted (elbow) or straightened (curved) in Keynote (kn-elbow-connector, kn-curved-connector); shapes without text; rotated narrow text.
Pictures with crops, masks, recolor and SVG; links on the shape of video captions (14, 15); per-point bar colors (16, kn-per-point-colors); alt text Keynote does not show (kn-alt-text).

release.description: The whole corpus: every deck of `decks` in every variant.

full.description: The corpus in every variant, plus the decks the runner builds from the named sources.

sources.native-fragments: The decks and slides that the `native:` key of each unreleased changelog fragment names (changes/*.md, NT-07).
sources.examples: Every example deck under examples/ that `decks` does not already name, exported in its default variant.
sources.gallery-layouts: Every layout of the default gallery (packages/gallery/catalog/layouts/) filled at three content sizes: short, typical and long.
sources.languages: One deck per language group of the language round (Latin, right to left, CJK, other scripts), in the default and native-body variants.

checks.opens: The file opens without a repair prompt or an error.
checks.slides: The app shows as many slides as OPF's preview draws.
checks.visual: Each slide matches OPF's preview (side-by-side sheet; the pixel difference is reported, the verdict is a reviewer's).
checks.noOverflow: No text runs past its text box (PowerPoint: TextFrame2 bound height and width against the frame, 1.5 pt tolerance).
checks.noShrink: No text box asks the app to shrink text on overflow (normAutofit with a font scale, or shrink-on-overflow).
checks.smartArt: The slide carries live SmartArt with one node per entry, the entries' text, and the expected layout; a node edit keeps every node's size.
checks.noSmartArt: The slide carries no SmartArt (native shapes instead).
checks.nativeChart: The slide carries a native chart (not a picture); its type is listed.
checks.nativeTable: The slide carries a native table whose cells take an edit.
checks.connectors: The slide carries native connectors glued at both ends.
checks.shapes: The slide carries native preset or freeform shapes with text.
checks.footer: Header and Footer: the footer, slide number and date placeholders the deck asks for are visible on that slide (hidden where the deck hides them) and the slide number is a live field that renumbers when a slide moves.
checks.roundtrip: A copy saved by the app imports back through `opf convert` with the deck's shapes, diagrams and arrangements.
checks.fallback: Where the app does not lay SmartArt out, the slide shows a drawing of it: Keynote shows the picture fallback (mc:Fallback, OPF's picture of the arrangement); LibreOffice Impress draws the SmartArt's own drawing part (docs/libreoffice.md); PowerPoint takes the SmartArt choice and never shows the fallback.
